title_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF PARIS
description_en: Apartment 2+1+2 for sale, Municipality of Paris A modern apartment is available for sale, located in one of the sought-after areas of Tirana, ideal for both residence and investment. The apartment is located on the top floor of a private building with a guard. Property details: • Net area: 320 m² • Floor: 5 Organization: • distribution corridor • Living and cooking area • 2 bedrooms • 1 Wardrobe • 1 Storage room • 2 Toilets • 2 Balconies Features and Advantages • Furnished • New building with high construction quality. • The building has only 5 apartments in total, offering peace and privacy. • Strategic position with good exposure for advertising. • Suitable for residential and business. • Unobstructed view of the Olympic Park • The invested apartment is 150 m2, there is also an uninvested part of 170 m2, ready for division into a duplex. • Paris Commune area guarantees immediate access to daily services, institutions and facilities Reference: PARK60759
